name: Obsidian Reflection Labyrinth
description: A maze of polished black mirrors where each turn shows not your reflection but a memory — yours, or someone else's, or one that hasn't happened yet.
prompt: Infinite labyrinth of polished obsidian mirrors, each panel reflecting different memories — childhood moments, strangers' lives, future possibilities, some reflections moving independently, dramatic chiaroscuro lighting, impossible architecture, recursive reflections, psychological surrealism, 8k, cinematic thriller aesthetic
caption: Careful which corridor you choose. Some memories bite back. 🖤🪞
